# M12 Siege of Iron (tag, snow): take Olaf's HQ 2 (9,6) in the heart of three mountain rings (outer x1..17,y0..13; middle x4..14,y3..10; inner x6..12,y5..8). Gaps: outer (5,13) (13,13) south and (17,8) east (toward Grit's spur); middle (9,10) south, (4,5) west, (14,8) east; inner (7,8) (11,8) south and (6,6) west. The gaps never line up: every ring forces a zigzag along a 1-2 cell corridor under the guns. Grit's HQ 3 (21,7) on the east spur (plain pocket x20..22,y5..9; mountain walls, entered from the south at (21,11) or from the outer ring's east gap at (17,8) through (18,8)..(19,8)). The player must reach both HQs (objective). Threat/answer: Grit's Artillery and Rockets (hold) in the corridors -> Aurelia's extra range, Recons to find them, Bombers from the airport (12,15) (the Missiles (9,1) and AA (3,11) are far from the south corridor: strike the guns there first), Mechs and Infantry over the mountains straight to the guns; Olaf's Tanks and Md Tanks pour out of the gaps -> Tanks/Md Tanks and Artillery hold the gaps, Rockets/Artillery fire at the choke; Olaf's AA vs the Bomber -> use Artillery on it or Bombers where it cannot reach. Player start: ART3 ROCK2 RECON3 INF4 MECH3 TANK3 MDT2 AA1 BMB1 (21 units), HQ (9,15), base (7,15), airport (12,15), funds 5000. Olaf: INF4 + MECH2 hold the inner ring, MDT3 TANK3 AA1 advance, ART1 holds; Grit: ART4 ROCK2 MIS1 hold, INF2 MECH1 hold at the spur (24 units, about 1.3x).
